fd_name.description: Unique name of this File Daemon — must match what the Director expects.

fd_port.description: TCP port on which the File Daemon listens for Director connections.

log_file.description: Path to the File Daemon's main log file.

pid_directory.description: Directory where the FD writes its process ID file.

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum number of backup/restore jobs this daemon can run simultaneously.

working_directory.description: Working directory for temporary files, spooling, and working storage.

fd_addresses.description: List of addresses the FD binds to. Usually 127.0.0.1 (localhost) for security.

directors.description: List of Directors authorized to connect to this File Daemon. Each entry must match the Director's configuration.

name.description: Name of the Director (must match Director resource name).

address.description: IP address or hostname of the Director.

fd_port.description: Port the Director uses to connect to this File Daemon (typically 9101).

password.description: Shared secret password used for Director authentication.

tls_enable.description: Whether to require TLS encryption for this Director connection.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS (optional; leave empty if not using TLS auth).

tls_cert.description: Path to this daemon's TLS certificate (optional).

tls_key.description: Path to this daemon's TLS private key (optional).

catalog.description: Optional catalog configuration for metadata lookup during restores.

messages.description: Message destinations (console, mail, append, catalog). Each key is a messages block name.

target.description: Target for the message (e.g., address:port, file path, or email).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS globally for all FD connections (overrides per-director if true).

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS verification.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to File Daemon's TLS certificate.

tls_key_file.description: Path to File Daemon's TLS private key.

plugins.description: List of plugins to load for enhanced backup functionality (e.g., VSS, LVM, etc.).

path.description: Path to the shared library (.so) for the plugin.

options.description: Key-value configuration options for the plugin.

autochanger.description: Autochanger/robotic library definition (rare — only if FD also acts as Storage Daemon).

changer_command.description: Command/script used to control the autochanger mechanism.
